editorial:
Imagine being a little girl who has to deal with a scary stepfather, but you have a secret weapon: your dad's ghost. That is exactly what you get in this wild ride. You will meet Sarah, a brave kid who just wants her mom to be safe and happy again. The movie mixes some really sad family drama with weird, funny moments that keep you guessing. It feels like a dark fairy tale where a child has to be the adult in the room to fix a broken home, and the bond between Sarah and her late father is the heart of the whole thing.

You will probably love how the twists keep you on your toes, even if some of the pacing feels a bit slow in the middle. The acting is natural, making the scary parts feel real and the funny parts land well. If you enjoy stories about family secrets and a bit of the supernatural, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Sarah's plan to get rid of her stepfather takes a turn when the ghost of her father reveals he cannot simply wish the bad guy away. After a tense confrontation, the stepfather is finally removed from their lives, but not in the way you expect. Sarah and her mother find peace and healing together, knowing her father is still watching over them from the other side.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about family bonds and supernatural twists.
